CuCrZr.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and properties of CuCrZr prepared by laser powder bed fusion
CuCrZr.authors_or_organization: X. Chen et al., Materials Characterization
CuCrZr.notes: The paper reports 314.3 +/- 5.3 W/(m K) after direct aging.  The embedded elevated-temperature curve is a rounded screening curve consistent with the reported LPBF electrical/thermal trend; verify the actual build and heat lot for detailed design.

IN625.title: INCONEL alloy 625 technical bulletin, Table 3
IN625.notes: Annealed 2100 F for one hour; measured by Battelle Memorial Institute.
IN625.manufacturing_condition: Wrought, annealed at 1149 C for one hour

IN718.title: INCONEL alloy 718 technical bulletin, Table 5
IN718.notes: Annealed and aged condition. Conductivity is calculated from the manufacturer's resistivity measurements.

AlSi10Mg.title: Thermophysical Properties of Laser Powder Bed Fused Ti-6Al-4V and AlSi10Mg Alloys Made with Varying Laser Parameters
AlSi10Mg.notes: Figure 2f reports temperature-dependent L-PBF data. LPA uses the 100 W, 0.2 m/s series; the 118.2 and 172.0 W/(m K) endpoints are reported by the authors and intermediate markers are rounded from the figure. Build parameters and porosity must be matched for design.
AlSi10Mg.manufacturing_condition: LPBF, as-built, 100 W and 0.2 m/s scan speed

C103.title: C-103 Niobium Alloy, Alloy Digest Cb-25
C103.notes: Rounded engineering values for Nb-10Hf-1Ti are used. Published C-103 data vary with product form and temperature history; verify the supplier heat for life or margin assessment.

Ti64.title: Prediction of Space Shuttle TPS panel heating, Table II
Ti64.notes: Table II temperature-dependent data for a Ti-6Al-4V panel.
